predictions.rationale: Core utility dedicated to catching uncaught AWT exceptions and routing them to the ArgoUML logging infrastructure; directly supports debug/trace output.
Utility class for timing code sections and emitting elapsed-time information to the logger; frequently used while tracing performance during debugging.
Alternative exception handler located in the application package; integrates with security manager and forwards stack traces to the logging system.
Developer panel whose very purpose is to display the undo log; provides UI access to logged undo/redo operations for tracing problems.
Wraps the global undo manager to record and expose detailed undo/redo events, feeding data to the UndoLogPanel and contributing log information.
Inspector panel for the event pump; enables developers to trace and view internal events, effectively acting as a live event log.
Displays current GEF modes for diagnostic purposes; assists developers in logging and tracing UI interaction states.
Diagnostic panel exposing TargetManager state changes; used to observe and log target selection events during debugging.
Builds caller lists for stack inspection; supports creation of detailed call traces helpful in logging runtime behaviour.
Initialises the developer tools (including the various *Log* panels); indirectly enables logging and tracing facilities within the development module.
